test_fused_qknorm_rope: test the fused_qk_norm_rope JIT kernel against a pure-PyTorch reference with RMSNorm and RoPE
test_fused_qknorm_rope_partial_rotary: test the fused_qk_norm_rope kernel with partial rotary dimensions where rotary_dim is less than head_dim
test_fused_qknorm_rope_yarn_scaling: test the fused_qk_norm_rope kernel with YaRN scaling factors and extended context window parameters
test_fused_qknorm_rope_default_rotary_di: test that fused_qk_norm_rope with rotary_dim=None defaults to full head_dim rotation
test_fused_qknorm_rope_vs_aot: test the fused_qk_norm_rope JIT kernel against the AOT sgl_kernel implementation
